blocks.text: SM Hotels and Conventions Corp. (SMHCC) is set to open the doors of SMX Convention Center Seaside Cebu with two major industry exhibitions from November 26 to 28, 2026, as the 15th Anniversary Edition of PHILCONSTRUCT Visayas and Visayas Business Connect Expo 2026 take center stage at the new venue. PHILCONSTRUCT Visayas (brought to you by the Philippine Constructors Association (PCA) & managed by Global-Link MP) and the Visayas Business Connect Expo (organized by Global-Link MP) are taking over two levels of SMX Seaside Cebu, marking the first major industry gatherings to be staged at the facility.
